figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Enzymatic synthesis of TDP-L-digitoxose (19). (A) Purified TDP-
4-keto-6-deoxy-D-glucose (13). (B) Incubation mixture containing 13 (1
mM), TylX3 (160 nM), KijD10 (360 nM), and NADPH (1.2 mM) in 50
mM Tris‚HCl, pH 7.5, 20% glycerol showing formation of TDP-4-keto-
2,6-dideoxy-D-glucose (16). (C) Incubation mixture containing 16 (1 mM)
and KijD11 (100 nM) in 50 mM Tris‚HCl, pH 7.5, showing formation of
TDP-4-keto-2,6-dideoxy-L-allose (17). (D-G) TDP-4-keto-2,6-dideoxy-D-
glucose (16, 1 mM), KijD11 (100 nM), KijC2 (10 µM), NADH (1.4 mM),
and MgCl2 (10 mM) in 50 mM Tris‚HCl, pH 7.5, 10% glycerol after 1 h,
2, 4, and 8 h, respectively, showing time-dependent formation of 19.
